blocks.text: In the tropical forests you may spot toucans, scarlet macaws and many other bird species. Cockscomb Basin Wildlife Sanctuary is also known as one of the world’s first reserves established to protect jaguars. The trip ends in San Pedro on Ambergris Caye, with visits to Hol Chan Marine Reserve and Shark Ray Alley.
